newsitem.title: FRANCE: Signaux shares higher on H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Signaux shares higher on H1 results.

text.p: French electronics and defence group Cie des Signaux was up more than three percent on Tuesday on the back of its first-half results but off its intraday high.
By 1255 GMT, the share was up 7.1 francs or 3.36 percent at 218.10 francs after originally trading as high as 228.90 francs. Volume totalled 21,659 shares .

The company reported on Monday that half year net attributable profits excluding exceptionals and before goodwill amortisation was 42 million francs compared with zero for the previous half year period.
It said it expected an increase in net profit for full-year 1996, including exceptional elements and capital gains, over 1995.
